title: '@@ bof' is a scope header, not BOF: with a +-only body it is E412 (with an uppercase hint)
notes: §12 item 14: E412 covers scope headers and precedes E418 (§8.3 'a hunk with header `@@`, a unified header, or a scope header whose body contains `+` lines and no anchor element'; §7.1 form 4 '`@@ bof` ... with a `+`-only body they are E412'). E412 is a hunk-level parse code without a single line, so it is reported at the hunk header line (§8.6 'offending line', §12 item 34).
